blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: . A recognizer that compares rotation-invariant descriptors sees a surface only up to the fiber of the descriptor. We measure this fiber by its radius in the orbit distance from the enrolled surface. A large radius admits decoys, that is, distant shapes that pass the matcher. A small radius discloses the enrolled shape to anyone who captures the stored value. For star-shaped surfaces truncated to spherical harmonics of degree at most L L , with n n coefficients, a descriptor of generic rank r r has generic fibers of dimension n − 3 − r n-3-r modulo rotations. The standard pool of band powers, even bispectra, and three invariants of the degree-three band therefore admits decoy families of dimension 5 5 , 13 13 , 20 20 at L = 4 , 6 , 8 L=4,6,8 . Its rank first reaches n − 3 n-3 at L = 16 L=16 , and a mirror decoy remains at every L L . The odd bispectra remove the mirror decoy generically for L ≥ 4 L\geq 4 . Yet at fixed mean radius the same pool determines the enclosed volume exactly, and it does not determine whether a surface meets a clearance requirement. We certify two cases by exact and interval arithmetic. At L = 6 L=6 a decoy matches all 32 32 invariants to relative precision 2 ⋅ 10 − 18 2\cdot 10^{-18} at orbit distance at least 0.87 0.87 times the norm of the enrolled tuple. For the radar shape model of asteroid (101955) Bennu, the pool recovers the modeled volume, misses the handedness, and leaves the keep-out radius uncertain by more than 7 ​ m 7\,\mathrm{m} .

blocks.en: 1. Introduction
blocks.zh: 1. 联合国 导言

blocks.en: Consider a recognizer that identifies three-dimensional objects from their geometry and must ignore the pose of the object. A standard way to do this is to replace the surface by a descriptor that is invariant under rotations, and to compare the descriptor with an enrolled library. The recognizer then sees only the descriptor. Two surfaces with the same descriptor are indistinguishable from that representation alone. The set of such surfaces is the fiber of the descriptor, and we measure it modulo rotations. We analyze this fiber from two adversarial perspectives: decoy construction and disclosure from a released descriptor.
blocks.zh: 考虑一个识别器,从其几何中识别出三维物体,必须忽略物体的姿势. 一种标准的方法是用一个在旋转下变化不定的描述符来取而代之,并将描述符和已注册的库作比较. 认取者然后只见说者. 有两个表面有相同的描述符,仅与这种表述无法区分。 这种表面的一组是描述器的纤维, 我们测量它的自旋。 我们从两个对立的角度来分析这种纤维:诱饵构造和从释放的描述器上披露.

blocks.en: The first adversary builds decoys. A decoy is a surface that is not a rotated copy of an enrolled object but has the same descriptor, up to the tolerance of the recognizer. At zero tolerance a decoy lies in the exact fiber; at positive tolerance it lies in a thickened fiber. Large fibers therefore permit geometrically distinct accepted shapes. A fiber of positive dimension modulo rotations is a whole family of decoys; this ambiguity is intrinsic to the representation and exists independently of classifier training. Every classifier that acts on the descriptor is constant on its fibers, so no training removes them. The second adversary obtains the stored descriptor of an enrolled object. A captured descriptor is consistent with every surface in its fiber, so small fibers disclose the enrolled geometry. We measure both threats by one number, the radius of the fiber in the orbit distance, centered at the enrolled surface. For a fixed admissible set and tolerance, this radius, centered at the enrolled point, has a decoy interpretation and a disclosure interpretation. An observer who knows only the released value faces a different uncertainty, which is governed by the orbit diameter, or by the corresponding minimax radius, of the set of surfaces consistent with that value. The diameter lies between the radius and twice the radius ( Prop. 3.3 ). This statement concerns the shape as a whole. It does not address the accuracy of a particular task, and it is not a statistical notion of privacy.

blocks.en: The setting is that of [ 15 , 16 ] . A star-shaped surface is given by its radial function on the sphere, truncated to spherical harmonics of degree at most L L . Rotations act band by band on the coefficients, and descriptors are polynomial invariants of the coefficient tuple. A descriptor that separates orbits admits no exact decoys; conversely, an exact released value determines the enrolled orbit. On a compact semialgebraic admissible set, the radius of any descriptor at tolerance ε \varepsilon exceeds its exact radius by at most C ​ ε α C\varepsilon^{\alpha} , with constants that may depend on the enrolled tuple. The stability inequality of [ 15 ] bounds the orbit distance by a Hölder power of the descriptor discrepancy. It was proved there to certify the descriptor. Read as a disclosure statement, it says that a released descriptor known to accuracy ε \varepsilon locates the enrolled surface within orbit distance C ​ ε α C\varepsilon^{\alpha} . On the dipole and quadrupole bands the separation proof of [ 15 ] is constructive and yields an explicit reconstruction.

blocks.en: A descriptor that does not separate admits decoys, and the constant-rank theorem measures how many. Let the descriptor have generic rank r r on a coefficient space of dimension n n . Modulo rotations, the part of its fiber in the free maximal-rank locus is a manifold of dimension n − 3 − r n-3-r . If r = n − 3 r=n-3 , that regular part is a finite union of orbits. If r < n − 3 r<n-3 , the recognizer accepts a family of decoys of positive dimension near every generic enrolled surface. A descriptor with fewer than n − 3 n-3 components is always in the second case, whatever its components are.

blocks.en: The standard spectral pool consists of the band powers of [ 10 ] , the even bispectra of [ 9 ] , and three invariants of the band-three sextic. It is the invariant block used in [ 16 ] . We compute its generic rank exactly. For 2 ≤ L ≤ 15 2\leq L\leq 15 the rank equals the size of the pool, which is less than n − 3 n-3 . At the cutoffs L = 4 , 6 , 8 L=4,6,8 the decoy families have dimension 5 5 , 13 13 , and 20 20 . At L = 16 L=16 the rank reaches n − 3 n-3 for the first time, and the continuous ambiguity disappears on the free maximal-rank locus. A discrete ambiguity remains. The pool consists of true scalars, so a surface and its mirror image have the same pool. For every surface that is not a rotated copy of its mirror image, the mirror image is an exact decoy, at every L L , and at L = 16 L=16 the finite ambiguity still contains the mirror pair. The odd bispectra are pseudoscalars. For L ≥ 4 L\geq 4 , adjoining them removes the mirror decoy for generic surfaces; the augmented pool first saturates at L = 10 L=10 . The latter threshold also follows from the degree-three orbit-recovery theorem of [ 7 ] .

blocks.en: Whole-shape ambiguity does not settle task utility. We therefore introduce task intervals and prove an exact attribute-disclosure result: at a fixed constant radial term, the even pool determines enclosed volume. An explicit pair of positive radial surfaces has identical descriptors and volumes but opposite outcomes for a specified clearance requirement. The example can be checked by hand, so the conflict is exhibited for a stated task and is not merely inferred from a difference in shape. In Sec. 11 the same analysis is applied to the radar shape model of the near-Earth asteroid (101955) Bennu, with certified descriptor, distance, positivity, and task bounds for the rounded L = 6 L=6 model.
blocks.zh: 全形模糊不能解决任务效用. 因此,我们采用任务间隔并证明准确的属性披露结果:在一个固定不变的光圈中,偶数池决定了封闭体积。 明确对正射线表面具有相同的说明和体积,但结果与规定的清除要求相反。 可以手工检查这个例子,因此,冲突是用来执行既定任务的,而不只是从形状的不同推断出来的。 第11项中,对近地小行星的雷达外形模型(101955年)进行了同样的分析。 Bennu,具有认证的描述符,相距,正向,并具有四舍五入L=6L=6型号的任务界限.

blocks.en: The coefficient model assumes a fully observed closed surface that is star-shaped about a specified origin. A centroid convention is an additional constraint. It follows neither from positivity nor from omitting the constant harmonic, and Sec. 10.1 states it explicitly. Surfaces of higher genus and partial views are outside this model. The discussion of applications in Sec. 10.4 proposes a validation setting; it makes no claim about any deployed system.
blocks.zh: 系数模型假设一个完全被观测到的封闭地表,其星形大约为特定起源. 半人马公约是另一个制约因素。 它既不是绝对性的,也不是忽略了常有的口琴,第10.1条明确指出了这一点。 高等流派和部分取景的表面都在这个模型之外. 第10.4节关于应用的讨论提出了一个验证设置;它不对任何部署的系统提出任何要求。

blocks.en: We compare these ranks with known orbit-recovery results. For one spherical function including the constant band, [ 7 , Thm. 4.1 and Cor. 4.2] proves finite generic recovery from invariants of degree at most three for every L ≥ 10 L\geq 10 . On ℋ 0 ⊕ U L \mathcal{H}_{0}\oplus U_{L} the invariants of degree at most three are polynomials in f 0 f_{0} , the powers, and the even and odd bispectra. Finite generic recovery gives their map the generic rank ( L + 1 ) 2 − 3 (L+1)^{2}-3 . Fixing f 0 f_{0} lowers the rank by at most one, so the powers and bispectra have generic rank at least n − 3 n-3 on U L U_{L} ; adjoining the sextic invariants cannot lower it. In particular, r + ​ ( L ) = n − 3 r^{+}(L)=n-3 holds for every L ≥ 10 L\geq 10 , and the saturation of Φ L + \Phi^{+}_{L} at L = 10 L=10 is not a new generic-recovery threshold. The comparison made here concerns the even pool Φ L \Phi_{L} , its radii and mirror ambiguity, and the information retained for particular tasks.

blocks.en: For exact descriptor collisions, every deterministic predictor h ∘ Φ h\circ\Phi takes the same value at both shapes. Thus if the required task values differ, no such predictor can be correct at both. At positive tolerance, closeness of two descriptors alone does not imply that an arbitrary predictor assigns them the same label. The corresponding impossibility statement concerns a common observation y y : if both shapes lie in its consistent set, no decision based only on that observation can be guaranteed correct for both under the stated error model.
blocks.zh: 对于精确的描述式相撞,每个定型预测器 h ∘ h\ circ\ Phi 在两种形状上都具有相同的值. 因此,如果所需任务值不同,则这两种预测都不可能正确。 从正面的可容忍性来看,仅靠两个描述符的相近性并不意味着任意的预测符为它们指定了相同的标签. 相应的不可能声明涉及一个共同的观察y y :如果两个形状都位于其一致的集合中,那么在所述错误模型下,仅基于该观察的任何决定都不能保证两者正确.

blocks.en: 10.4. Use in independent evaluation
blocks.zh: 10.4 (英语). 独立评价中的用途

blocks.en: The framework is intended primarily for evaluators who select or test geometric representations, not for operators who apply a radius to an unspecified field observation. The input is one documented representation, one admissible shape model, a calibrated error budget, and a task requirement. The output is a task certificate, a verified conflicting pair, or an unresolved case. A failure to find a conflicting shape is not a certificate of its absence. Similarly, a numerical distance computed at one aligning rotation bounds the orbit distance from above only; Cor. 7.3 gives the lower bound needed to certify geometric separation.
blocks.zh: 该框架主要针对选择或测试几何表示法的评价人员,而不是对未指明的实地观测应用半径的操作人员. 投入是一份书面陈述、一份可接受形状模型、一份校正错误预算和一项任务要求。 输出是一个任务证书,一个经核实相冲突的对子,或者一个未解决的案件. 未能找到相冲突的形状并不是其缺失的证明. 同样,一个对齐旋转时计算出的数字距离仅将轨道距离从上方限制;第7.3节给出了证明几何分离所需的下方界限。

blocks.en: One such setting is an independent validation study of scan-based identification or inspection of equipment or calibration objects, for instance in defense or aerospace programs. Such a study is relevant only if the representation under test actually discards geometry in the manner modeled here. A comparison against complete geometry does not automatically inherit a collision of Φ L \Phi_{L} .
blocks.zh: 其中一种情况是对设备或校准物体进行扫描识别或检查的独立验证研究,例如在国防或航空航天方案中。 这种研究只有在试验下的表示实际放弃此处所模拟的几何学时才具有相关性。 与完全几何比较不会自动继承QQ L\Phi_{L}相撞.

blocks.en: A focused validation would first reproduce the exact quadrupole formulas and Prop. 9.3 . It would then use a controlled collection of fully observed radial objects with independently measured reference geometry, evaluate band powers, the even pool, and a task-augmented representation under the same acquisition and preprocessing conditions, and report task-error bounds, conflicting decisions, the fraction of unresolved cases, computation time, and descriptor storage. The high-band benchmark of Sec. 7 is a certified calibration case for such a comparison, and Sec. 11 applies the same audit to a space object.

blocks.en: Ex. 11.1 has the following implications for the two adversarial perspectives and for the keep-out task. The even pool at L = 6 L=6 determines the modeled volume of Bennu, and hence its mass for a given bulk density. It does not determine the handedness of the asteroid: the mirror image matches all 32 32 components exactly and lies at orbit distance at least 5 ​ m 5\,\mathrm{m} . The odd bispectra do determine it. The even pool does not determine the keep-out radius either. The requirement T out ≤ 277 ​ m T_{\mathrm{out}}\leq 277\,\mathrm{m} holds for c c and fails for d + d_{+} . The requirement T out ≤ 273 ​ m T_{\mathrm{out}}\leq 273\,\mathrm{m} holds for d − d_{-} and fails for c c . For every admissible set K K containing c c , d + d_{+} and d − d_{-} , the task interval of T out T_{\mathrm{out}} at the value Φ 6 ​ ( c ) \Phi_{6}(c) with componentwise relative tolerance 10 − 14 10^{-14} has width at least 279.588 − 272.172 = 7.416 ​ m 279.588-272.172=7.416\,\mathrm{m} . By Prop. 8.2 , every estimate of the keep-out radius from that value has worst-case error at least 3.708 ​ m 3.708\,\mathrm{m} on these three tuples. The modeled volumes of d + d_{+} and d − d_{-} differ from that of c c by at most 2 ⋅ 10 − 16 ​ m 3 2\cdot 10^{-16}\,\mathrm{m}^{3} . The continuation that produced d ± d_{\pm} imposes no centroid constraint. The example therefore audits the representation with the center-of-mass origin of the radar model held fixed, as in Sec. 10.1 , and not a pipeline that recenters every candidate shape.

blocks.en: 12. Conclusion
blocks.zh: 12. 结论

blocks.en: The fiber radius measures geometric ambiguity, but does not by itself determine task utility or attribute confidentiality. Continuous ambiguity, discrete mirror ambiguity, finite-precision instability, and task ambiguity are distinct. The spectral pool gives a concrete example: its fibers can leave the shape undetermined while fixing enclosed volume exactly. The explicit clearance pair shows, without a numerical search, that a second geometric decision can remain impossible from the same descriptor. In an audit seeded by the radar shape model of Bennu, these phenomena appear together: the even pool fixes the modeled volume, misses the handedness, and, at componentwise relative descriptor tolerance 10 − 14 10^{-14} , leaves the keep-out radius uncertain by more than 7 ​ m 7\,\mathrm{m} . Together with task intervals, observer-centered reconstruction bounds, and the analysis of combined releases, this gives a precise basis for evaluating what a retained geometric representation can certify and what sharing it discloses.
blocks.zh: 纤维半径测量几何模糊度,但本身并不确定任务效用或属性保密性. 持续的模糊性、离散的镜面模糊性、有限的精确性不稳定性和任务模糊性是不同的。 光谱池给出了具体的例子:它的纤维可以在精确地固定封闭体积的同时使外形不固定. 明确的通关对子显示,没有数字搜索,从同一描述符中仍然无法得出第二个几何决定. 在由本努的雷达外形模型所引出的审计中,这些现象一起出现:偶数池会修补模型体积,错失了"交接";而从构件上看,相对的描述可容性10 - 14 10 - 14 } 使保存半径不确定, 超过 7 m 7\\\ mathrm{ m}. 再加上任务间隔、以观察员为中心的重建界限以及对综合释放的分析,这为评价保留的几何表示能够证明哪些内容以及披露哪些内容提供了确切的基础。
